features.title: Observation-grounding contract for pose-dependent actions
acceptance: pick/place (any skill with coordinate args) execute only if grounded in a world_state the loop returned to the LLM in a tool result of the current episode; otherwise FailureCode.UNGROUNDED_ACTION before any env execution
Grounding snapshot captured once per llm.step turn; results produced during a turn ground only later turns (observe+pick and pick+place in one turn are rejected)
Grounding records rebuilt from the delivered world_state, reset per episode; task text, memory text and model output never ground (memory with coordinates in its text still rejected)
pick: target object present in the delivered state and not moved beyond GRASP_TOL since; unrelated objects moving do not invalidate
place: delivered gripper holding state equals live holding state (destination/support pose not grounded)
Check runs after validate_call (existing codes keep precedence) and once per tool call (GRASP_SLIP retries unchanged)

Rejections return fresh world_state, count toward max_failures, and are logged as grounding_check + validation_error; grounding_check records source_seq, source_call_id, source_step, live_step; llm_turn records grounding_source_seq/grounding_step

Tests: 27 new loop tests + 2 unit tests (blind-correct pick, multi-call turns, reset isolation, failure/SKIPPED state grounding, holding transitions, target moved while planning, message mutation during step, failure budget, memory parse of UNGROUNDED trace); 7 older tests gained an initial observe or a restructured turn, assertions unchanged
Mutation check: with grounding disabled, all 9 original rejection tests fail
Non-server suite 128 passed, 5 skipped, 3 deselected; full suite with local Ollama 131 passed, 5 skipped
features.notes: Interfaces unchanged (LLMClient, RobotEnv, SYSTEM_PROMPT, memory retrieval, model settings). Limitations: place destination/support pose is not grounded; pick does not compare holding state, so a contrived same-turn place-then-pick at the carry position passes; requires_grounding keys on an 'x' arg, so future coordinate skills need explicit freshness rules; Grounding.state is a mutable pydantic model that no code mutates; no max state age (needed for real hardware); robosuite tests not run (ROBOT_AGENT_ROBOSUITE_PYTHON unset); once a state is delivered, a guess within GRASP_TOL is indistinguishable from reading it. features.title: Naive vs dependency-aware deterministic policies for clear_target (mock)
acceptance: src/robot_agent/policies.py: NaivePolicy and DependencyAwarePolicy over one pure decide(latest_state(messages), subgoals, aware); constructor takes InRegion subgoals only (no env, no coordinates); stateless; at most one tool call per turn
Naive: follows the supplied subgoal order, places at the goal region centre without checking occupancy, repeats a rejected action (bounded by the loop's failure budget)

Dependency-aware: if the current subgoal's destination is occupied in the delivered state, picks the blocker (stop if the blocker's own subgoal already holds), places it at its own free goal or the nearest valid staging point (0.05 m grid within ±0.45, footprint >= REGION_HALF+CUBE_HALF from every region), then resumes

clear_target: naive/correct and DA/correct goal_met in 4 executes; naive/reversed failure_budget after 8 validation-layer DESTINATION_OCCUPIED (10 turns, 1 execute); DA/reversed goal_met in the optimal 4 executes with 0 rejections

Extra layouts: swap (DA stages red at (-0.35, 0.3), 6 executes, optimal), blocker without subgoal (DA stages blue at (-0.05, 0.3)), free target (both follow the supplied order, no false dependency), recovery after a rejected plan (1 rejected plan, reactively recovered, 6 executes)

tests/test_policies.py (23 tests): independent physical oracle (own footprint geometry + goals.InRegion capacity) on every traced state; grounding provenance for every call (state read = previous tool_result, pick args = delivered pose, place = held cube's own goal centre or valid staging); no env access (constructor signature, synthetic states, layout shift); no hidden state; livelock detector; single-object task matches PickPlacePolicyLLM

Test-local metrics: success, violations attempted (validation layer) vs env-rejected vs invalid_state_observations, turns, physical executions, successful skills, unnecessary actions (None on failed episodes), proactive clearances computed from the trace vs proactive resolutions from the policy's meta.mode, rejected plans (grouped only when adjacent), unattributed rejections, reactive recoveries
Mutations (traces/f011b1_v1/): 10, each failing its targeted tests
Non-server suite 172 passed, 17 skipped, 3 deselected; robosuite suite 22 passed
features.notes: No changes to AgentLoop, mock env, goal checker, memory, SYSTEM_PROMPT, tool schemas or existing policies; no CLI, live LLM or disturbance (B006) work. Proactive measures differ by design: the trace count is outcome-based (blocker left another object's goal region before any attempt to fill it), meta is decision intent, so naive/correct counts 1 vs 0 and swap 2 vs 1. Deferred limitations: (a) stop paths untested — 'conflicting goals' (needs overlapping regions), 'no valid staging location', 'blocked but no blocking cube', naive 'holding a cube with no subgoal', and the duplicate-object constructor check; (b) a subgoal object or region missing from the delivered state raises KeyError, which AgentLoop reports as llm_error rather than a typed stop; (c) _blocker duplicates placement_conflict geometry and the equivalence test covers only states traced in four layouts (no overlapping regions, boundary cases or two cubes in one region); (d) On-goal tasks unsupported; (e) no evaluation harness or live comparison yet.

features.title: Symbolic dependency planner for unordered in-region goals (mock backend)
acceptance: robot_agent.planner.plan(goals, state, bounds=WORKSPACE, max_physical=None) -> Plan | PlanningFailure (pydantic); never touches a RobotEnv; the input WorldState is deep-copied and unchanged

Strict validation: InRegion only with REGION_HALF; unknown/non-cube objects, unknown/non-region regions, duplicates, empty -> INVALID_GOALS (subcode); two cubes one region / one cube two regions -> INFEASIBLE_GOALS; bounds outside WORKSPACE, goal region or pick outside bounds -> OUT_OF_BOUNDS; overlapping regions or non-cube/region objects -> UNSUPPORTED_GEOMETRY; inconsistent held object -> INVALID_STATE
Goals canonicalised (sorted (object_id, region)); presentation order cannot influence the plan
Rollout of policies.decide(aware=True) over mock kinematics with per-turn priority: destination free first, then blocker without its own goal, then cycles (one staging move each), canonical tie-break

Structured policy stops: decide() text-only turns carry meta['code'] (NO_SUBGOAL_FOR_HELD, NO_STAGING, BLOCKER_NOT_FOUND, CONFLICTING_GOALS); text unchanged; planner maps them without substring matching; unknown stops and policy-proposed conflicting places -> PLANNER_INTERNAL
Staging grid parameterised by bounds and shared: policies._staging_points(bounds=WORKSPACE), _staging(s, held, bounds=WORKSPACE), decide(..., bounds=WORKSPACE); defaults preserve F011b-1 behaviour
Bound 4 * n_cubes physical actions (BOUND_EXCEEDED); finish checked before the bound
Not connected to AgentLoop; plans are open-loop and must be grounded and re-planned by a future executor (F012c)

features.notes: Evidence of optimality is empirical on the F012b-1 corpus (cube-only, disjoint regions, up to 4 cubes, full workspace for BFS; BFS ignores bounds). BLOCKER_NOT_FOUND and the policy CONFLICTING_GOALS stop are unreachable through validated inputs and are tested via monkeypatch / decide() directly. Plans carry no expected post-states yet. Robosuite supports one cube and one region and its reach/barrier are not expressible as rectangular bounds. LLM-extracted goals must not be connected (F012a-2: unsafe on unsupported/ambiguous instructions).
